observations: Torah #123 contains no bechina-type identifications whatsoever. The teaching is practical medical/spiritual advice about mikveh immersion and self-mortification. All relationships in the text are causal (eitza): mikveh opens pores → good for health; too-cold water → blocks pores; pride → harm from self-mortification. Without any bechina connections, no packages can be formed. The minimum threshold of 3 bechina-connected concepts forming an independent domain is not met. Key concepts mentioned (מקוה, טבילה, נקבי הזעה, בריאות הגוף, עבודות וסגופים, גדלות) are all related by cause-and-effect, not by shared essential nature.
